runtime.scheduling: One indexed exact-arithmetic pass; reuse endpoint totals across scopes; no shared settings modified

definitions.baseline: Saved mixed measured/model policy, not pure-model counterfactual
definitions.replay_gate: Every eligible baseline PF G, every saved baseline PF winner/tie and PR selection/cost/SE/ratio must agree exactly before replacement
definitions.selection: Fraction G ascending then lexical candidate_id; keep all exact ties
definitions.ranks: ordinal with lexical ties and competition rank; strict pairwise inversions and tie changes separately
definitions.PR: Copy saved selected PR total/SE/cohort without recomputing means, SE, shots or selecting new PR
